headline: Apple Beats Sales and Profit Estimates, Flags AI Cost Pressures
summary: Apple surpassed sales and profit expectations with a revenue record driven by iPhone sales and services, but warned that AI-related cost pressures are impacting holiday sales margins.
why: Apple is one of the world's largest technology companies by market capitalization, and its quarterly results and forward guidance heavily influence global technology sector sentiment and equity indices.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: Beating earnings estimates is positive, but margin pressures from AI costs create competing headwinds for the stock.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: While headline figures beat expectations, warnings about holiday margin compression from artificial intelligence investments introduced caution regarding near-term profitability.
